Mat’s lining up in the hybrid Lamborghini Revuelto to take on the monstrous new Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 and the undefeated launch-control king, the 992.2 Porsche 911 Turbo S! Three completely different engineering philosophies are going head-to-head over the standing quarter mile - so let’s see how the stats stack up before the lights go out!
